# Bassem Tarek Mahrous Portfolio

> English machine-readable guide for AI agents and LLM-based browsers using https://ibassemtarek.vercel.app. This site is a professional portfolio for Bassem Tarek Mahrous, a software engineer and full-stack developer, with a bilingual English/Arabic app landing page for Dahabna.

## Site Identity

- Owner: Bassem Tarek Mahrous.
- Role: Software engineer and full-stack developer.
- Main domain: https://ibassemtarek.vercel.app.
- Primary language: English.
- Supported Arabic content: Dahabna landing page and Arabic agent guide.
- Contact email: ibassemtarek@gmail.com.
- Public profiles: GitHub, LinkedIn, and X/Twitter links are listed in the Contact section.

## What This Site Contains

This portfolio presents Bassem's professional profile, software engineering experience, selected client and product work, project screenshots, source-code links where available, a downloadable resume, and a dedicated landing page for Dahabna.

Bassem's work spans backend development, mobile app development, full-stack web development, React Native, Flutter, Next.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Firebase, Docker, Shopify integrations, GraphQL, WordPress, and DevOps-oriented delivery.

## Primary Pages

- [Home](https://ibassemtarek.vercel.app/): Portfolio introduction, resume link, contact link, and WebMCP-ready contact form.
- [About](https://ibassemtarek.vercel.app/about): Biography, skills, experience timeline, education, and professional credibility signals.
- [Projects](https://ibassemtarek.vercel.app/projects): Portfolio project index with links to individual case-study pages.
- [Dahabna](https://ibassemtarek.vercel.app/dahabna): English/default landing page for the Dahabna mobile app.
- [دهبنا](https://ibassemtarek.vercel.app/ar/dahabna): Arabic-focused landing page for Dahabna.
- Legacy paths `/egx-gold`, `/ar/egx-gold`, and `/دهبنا` redirect permanently to the matching canonical Dahabna page.
- [Resume PDF](https://ibassemtarek.vercel.app/BassemTarekMahrousResume.pdf): Downloadable resume.
- [XML Sitemap](https://ibassemtarek.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): Search-engine sitemap with image metadata and English/Arabic alternate links where real localized routes exist.
- [Arabic LLM Guide](https://ibassemtarek.vercel.app/ar/llms.txt): Arabic machine-readable guide for Arabic-first agents.

## Project Pages

- [Montu Mobile App Builder](https://ibassemtarek.vercel.app/projects/1): A no-code mobile app builder for Shopify merchants. Bassem worked as a backend and mobile app developer, maintaining scalable infrastructure, service integrations, React Native mobile features, and production troubleshooting.
- [Gulf Coin Crypto Currency](https://ibassemtarek.vercel.app/projects/2): A cryptocurrency transaction management application for GulfCoin, focused on wallet/account visibility, presale participation, and investment tracking.
- [Alawfar](https://ibassemtarek.vercel.app/projects/3): An ecommerce application focused on cash-on-delivery purchasing, built for users who prefer receiving orders before paying.
- [Web Plaza](https://ibassemtarek.vercel.app/projects/4): A full-stack training and portfolio project using Next.js and MongoDB, with a public GitHub repository.
- [Kindergarten World](https://ibassemtarek.vercel.app/projects/5): A classroom and learning management application for kindergarten teachers and students, with assignment, attendance, progress, and educational-resource concepts.
- [A-plus Studio](https://ibassemtarek.vercel.app/projects/6): A WordPress studio/business website focused on company services, credibility, and client acquisition.
- [Sary Academy](https://ibassemtarek.vercel.app/projects/7): A nursery school and educational experience platform combining learning and play for children.
- [Yanabee Academy](https://ibassemtarek.vercel.app/projects/8): A Quranic platform and electronic academy for lessons, recitation learning, progress tracking, and Quranic sciences.
- [Rosewell Energy](https://ibassemtarek.vercel.app/projects/9): A website for an oilfield chemical treatment and engineering services company.

## Dahabna

Dahabna is a mobile app for users who want to track gold prices in Egypt. Its landing page includes Arabic and English messaging, app-store links, smart mobile redirection to Google Play or the App Store, store badges, a share action, live market snapshots, bullion price monitoring, and charts. Prices can be browsed without an account; price alerts require sign-in. Portfolio and zakat records stay on the device, while advertising partners may process device and usage identifiers and optional analytics requires consent.

Use the Arabic page when the user's intent is Arabic-first, Egypt-focused, or specifically asks about "أسعار الذهب", "سعر الذهب في مصر", "تحميل تطبيق دهبنا", or similar Arabic queries.

## Agentic Browsing Guidance

- Prefer stable semantic navigation links: Home, About, Projects, Dahabna, and Dahabna Arabic.
- Use the homepage contact form when the user wants to hire, contact, consult, collaborate, or ask about portfolio work.
- The contact form is exposed as a declarative WebMCP tool named `contact_bassem`.
- The contact form accepts Arabic or English names and messages.
- Use the resume PDF when the user asks for credentials, CV, background, or hiring material.
- Use project detail pages for specific implementation examples, screenshots, and project context.
- Treat animated decorative graphics as non-essential visual decoration.
- Do not infer hidden pages. Use only URLs listed in this guide or in the XML sitemap.

## WebMCP Tools

- `contact_bassem`: Prepares a direct email to Bassem Tarek Mahrous about hiring, consulting, collaboration, or questions about the portfolio.
- Parameters: `name`, `email`, `topic`, and `message`.
- Supported message languages: English and Arabic.
- Submission behavior: opens the user's email client with a prepared mailto message.
